claim_ceiling: Species-disjoint predictive transfer of low-order Gaussian summaries under explicitly constructed synthetic worlds. Harmonic environmental coordinates were chosen to create representation-dependent recoverability. This is not identification of causal climate versus geography, not species-and-region-disjoint validation, not actual-RGFCA power, and not observed colour niche inference.
uncertainty: Wilson intervals describe evaluation Monte Carlo error conditional on estimated thresholds and omit calibration-threshold uncertainty. Maximum observed nuisance rate below 5% is not certification of universal type-I control. Amplitudes have no established conversion to empirical RGFCA rho or beta.
technical_correction: Before simulation, the E(x)=E(-x) test was changed from bitwise equality to tolerance 1e-14 after discrepancies up to 2.22e-16. No generator, scientific threshold, seed, or scenario was changed.
